title: GPS-Q13-EIGHTH: sharper time envelope at unchanged cube-root copy growth

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-Q13-EIGHTH algorithm/configuration of proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch including failures, retries, discarded copies and aborts, charged sequential work is O(2^((2/3)n^(2/3)log2 n+n^(2/3)(log2 n)^(1/8))). The exact uniform envelope has growth index2/3 and an absolute outside constant. The finite branch is n<2^64; otherwise u=ceil(n^(1/3)), ell=ceil(log2 n), z=ceil(log2 ell), b=ceil(4u^2(ell+2z+9)/3), m=ceil((n-1)/b), with the exact wide tree, all-modulus decoders and two executed caps. Source/extraction, classical work, circuit generation, initialization, reset, measurement, addressing and abort cleanup are fully charged. This holds jointly with all other resource and error claims for the same configuration.

For the same GPS-Q13-EIGHTH algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak classical workspace on EVERY branch is O(n^2) bits with an absolute constant. All labels, frames, source and fallback caps, modular constants, extraction scratch and streamed decoder records are included. The exact uniform envelope n^2 has growth index0, jointly with full-secret success at least1-2^-8 and all other claims.

For the same GPS-Q13-EIGHTH algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum allocation on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including retained phase qubits, explicit search and arithmetic scratch, source transforms and extraction ancillas. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0, jointly with full-secret success at least1-2^-8 and all other claims.

For the same GPS-Q13-EIGHTH algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies, number O(2^((1/2)n^(1/3))) with an absolute outside constant. The literal main cap Qcap=1024(2G(nK+2n)+2n), with G=(2(b+1))^m, is at most2^((1/2)n^(1/3)) for every n>=2^64 by Section9.1. The finite exhaustive branch changes only an absolute outside constant. The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/3, jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other envelopes.

For the same GPS-Q13-EIGHTH algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
